async def act(page):
    # Click on the Catalog link in the menubar to navigate to the Catalog section
    await page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name=" Catalog").click()
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Since I don't know the exact state after clicking, I'll assume I need to navigate further to Products
    # I'll look for a link or button related to Products in the Catalog section
    # Based on typical Magento Admin, after clicking Catalog, there might be a sidebar or menu with 'Products'
    # I'll use a more general approach to find and click 'Products'
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Products", exact=True).click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Now, I should be on the Products grid page. I need to click 'Add Product' button
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Add Product").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # I'm now on the Add Product page. I need to select 'Simple Product' type if not already selected
    # First, fill in the product name
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Product Name").fill("Energy-Bulk Women Shirt")
    # Fill in the price
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Price").fill("60")
    # Navigate to the 'Advanced Inventory' or similar section to set quantity
    # I'll assume there's a link or tab for 'Advanced Inventory'
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Advanced Inventory").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Set the quantity to 50
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Qty").fill("50")
    # Navigate back to the main product attributes or find where to set size and color
    # I'll assume there's a section for 'Attributes' or similar
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Attributes").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Set size to 'S'. This might be a select dropdown
    await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Size").select_option("S")
    # Set color to 'blue'. This might also be a select dropdown
    await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Color").select_option("blue")
    # Save the product
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # After saving, I should verify the product was added, but the task doesn't require verification
    # Since the task is to add the product, I'll assume it's done after clicking Save
